title: 工具箱：四工具语义匹配—握取—端向对齐—完整入槽
phases: Identify hammer, tape measure, wrench and pliers and corresponding recesses; choose order keeping narrow slots and remaining grasps accessible.
Pick each tool at an observed handle/body location, avoiding fragile head-only grasps.
With fresh post-pick RGB, dock held tool using three directed material features and corresponding recess frame; destination seat denotes the visible final support.
Open only at the intended support; inspect full-tool containment and endpoint orientation.
Recover a missed placement using changed grip/arm/recess frame; finish all four and home. Do not invent a lid-closing requirement.
failure_lesson: Old local trials did not place any tool. Public references report partial progress, not a locally reproduced four-tool success. Closure/center alignment alone misses asymmetric recesses.
reference_success_scope: No full native success established by the reviewed aggregate/reference contract.
